svg.title: IsomerDB: containers (C4 level 2)
svg.text: What IsomerDB is made of, and how the parts talk to each other.
An app using Postgres or MongoDB
Documents by key, time travel, change
feeds, live streams; admin and usage.
Plans and routes SQL, holds the catalog, attaches to
existing Postgres, maintains projections (by key, or
incrementally across shards), issues write tokens, audits
for drift, proposes projections, meters usage.
